subject: Problem with weights: says different length, but from same dataframe

messages.author: c421bf0e5f229fd1
messages.subject: Problem with weights: says different length, but from same dataframe
parts:
Dear INLA users, 

I am using INLA_20.09.25 and Running under: Ubuntu 18.04.5 LTS.

I run the code: 

print(length(dataINLA$weight))
    print(length(dataINLA$weights_sample))
    print(dim(dataINLA))
    m = INLA::inla(formula = INLAFormula, family = "poisson", data = dataINLA, E = weight, weights =dataINLA$weights_sample, verbose = verbose,
                   control.fixed = list(prec.intercept = 1))

and get the error 
Length of 'weights' has to be the same as the length of the response: 641695 641731

while the output of the three print commands are the same.

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Problem with weights: says different length, but from same dataframe
parts:
Thanks for the quick reply.

We managed to solve it: 

do.call(inla,args=list(formula = INLAFormula, family = "poisson", data = dataINLA, E = dataINLA$weight, weights =dataINLA$weights_sample, verbose = verbose,
                   control.fixed = list(prec.intercept = 1)))

Seems like it has something do to with the environment. 

We use different functions calling the same dataset. 

The problem is that the dataset inla uses is not the same as the dataset I send in! The do.call call fixes that.
